featured_reviews.name: Sejal nagvekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would not recommend QDS Pro (Charni Road branch) to serious MBA CET aspirants. At the time of admission, weekly mocks were promised, but the actual experience did not meet those commitments.
The quant teaching, especially basics, was weak and chapters often felt rushed without proper understanding. Problem solving in class took excessive time, reducing productive learning.
I also raised concerns about the faculty, but no meaningful change was made. Overall, I felt misled by the promises made during admission and did not receive the quality of coaching I expected.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The best thing about QDS Pro’s CAT online coaching is their faculty. They’re not just there to teach—they actually want you to crack the exam. They track your progress, tell you exactly what to improve, and even give extra sessions if you need them. The mock tests were so similar to the actual CAT that I felt fully prepared on exam day. Their Verbal strategy also helped me boost my RC accuracy big time. Thanks to their support, I scored 99.2 percentile! If you’re looking for coaches who genuinely care about your success, QDS Pro is the place.
